notes: Fictional entity insert (TBox): a made-up class under a real class (the lungfish). It could exist unrecorded: the African lungfishes live in seasonal swamps and spend droughts buried in mud in poorly surveyed river basins, so a lineage there could go unnoticed. "Living" and "newly discovered" are in the statement so that the real count and closed list are touched (fossil lungfish are many). Determinate: two new members named in the prompt; the second also uses a real class fact above the edit (listed as the bridge and checked; the member fact in the prompt cannot be checked and is not listed). Indeterminate: the closed facts about the living lungfishes, asked as yes/no so that w2 has a concrete answer.
